contract.self_unregister: A listener can unregister itself while handling an active event
contract.current_event_continuity: Self-unregister does not prevent the remaining listeners from receiving the current event
contract.current_listener_delivery: The listener performing self-unregister receives the current event before removal
contract.post_unregister_registry: The self-unregistered listener is removed from the registry after the mutation
contract.subsequent_delivery: The removed listener does not receive subsequent events
contract.remaining_listener_preservation: Other listeners remain registered and continue receiving events
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after listener self-unregister
contract.permission_enforcement: Emit and unregister operations require the events permission
